COMMAND.name: mpls ldp
COMMAND.ACTION:
tertoos-cli candidate context mpls-ldp default
tertoos-cli candidate set mpls/ldp/default/enable true

COMMAND.name: mpls ldp vrf
COMMAND.help: Configure MPLS LDP for a VRF
COMMAND.ACTION:
tertoos-cli candidate context mpls-ldp ${vrf}
tertoos-cli candidate set mpls/ldp/${vrf}/enable true

COMMAND.name: install allow-broken-lsp
COMMAND.help: Install FECs without a downstream label as pop + IP forward (default)

COMMAND.name: no install allow-broken-lsp
COMMAND.help: Do not install FECs without a downstream label (transit drops them)

COMMAND.name: holdtime
COMMAND.help: Session holdtime in seconds (default 180; keepalives every holdtime/3)

COMMAND.name: no holdtime
COMMAND.help: Session holdtime back to the default (180 s)

COMMAND.name: keepalive
COMMAND.help: Not configurable: LDP sends keepalives every holdtime/3 (use holdtime)
COMMAND.ACTION: echo "% LDP keepalive is not configurable: it is always holdtime/3. Use 'holdtime' (3 x the keepalive you want)."; false

COMMAND.name: no discovery hello holdtime
COMMAND.help: Hello holdtime back to the default (15 s)

COMMAND.name: no discovery hello interval
COMMAND.help: Hello interval back to the default (5 s)

COMMAND.name: graceful-restart
COMMAND.help: Not supported: the LDP engine has no graceful restart
COMMAND.ACTION: echo "% LDP graceful restart is not supported by the TertoOS LDP engine."; false

COMMAND.name: no graceful-restart
COMMAND.help: Not supported: the LDP engine has no graceful restart
COMMAND.ACTION: echo "% LDP graceful restart is not supported by the TertoOS LDP engine (nothing to disable)."; false

COMMAND.name: graceful-restart helper
COMMAND.help: Not supported: the LDP engine has no graceful restart
COMMAND.ACTION: echo "% LDP graceful restart is not supported by the TertoOS LDP engine."; false

COMMAND.name: no graceful-restart helper
COMMAND.help: Not supported: the LDP engine has no graceful restart
COMMAND.ACTION: echo "% LDP graceful restart is not supported by the TertoOS LDP engine (nothing to disable)."; false

COMMAND.name: graceful-restart reconnect-time
COMMAND.help: Not supported: the LDP engine has no graceful restart
COMMAND.ACTION: echo "% LDP graceful restart is not supported by the TertoOS LDP engine."; false

COMMAND.name: graceful-restart recovery-time
COMMAND.help: Not supported: the LDP engine has no graceful restart
COMMAND.ACTION: echo "% LDP graceful restart is not supported by the TertoOS LDP engine."; false

COMMAND.name: address-family ipv4
COMMAND.ACTION:
tertoos-cli candidate context mpls-ldp-af ipv4
tertoos-cli candidate set mpls/ldp/${ldpvrf}/af/ipv4/enable true

COMMAND.name: address-family ipv6
COMMAND.ACTION:
tertoos-cli candidate context mpls-ldp-af ipv6
tertoos-cli candidate set mpls/ldp/${ldpvrf}/af/ipv6/enable true

COMMAND.name: neighbor
COMMAND.ACTION:
tertoos-cli candidate context mpls-ldp-nbr ${peer}
tertoos-cli candidate set mpls/ldp/${ldpvrf}/af/ipv4/neighbor/${peer}

COMMAND.name: discovery transport-address

PARAM.name: addr
PARAM.help: A.B.C.D or X:X::X (an address of this box, usually the loopback)

COMMAND.ACTION: tertoos-cli candidate set mpls/ldp/${ldpvrf}/af/${ldpafi}/discovery-transport-address ${addr} && { { ip -o addr show | awk '{split($4,p,/\//); print p[1]}'; tertoos-cli candidate show 2>/dev/null | awk '$0 ~ /^set interface\/[^\/]+\/ipv[46]\/address / {split($3,p,/\//); print p[1]}'; } | grep -qixF -- "${addr}" || echo "% Warning: ${addr} is not configured on any interface of this box (nor pending in this candidate). Accepted, but it is not used until the address exists."; }

COMMAND.name: label local allocate host-routes
COMMAND.help: Allocate labels for host routes (/32) only (default)

COMMAND.name: no label local allocate host-routes
COMMAND.help: Allocate labels for every prefix of the routing table

COMMAND.name: password
COMMAND.help: MD5 password for this neighbor (stored encrypted)

PARAM.name: enc
PARAM.help: 0=plain text | cipher=encrypted block from show running

COMMAND.name: holdtime
COMMAND.help: Session holdtime with this neighbor in seconds (restarts the session)

COMMAND.name: no holdtime
COMMAND.help: Use the global session holdtime with this neighbor

COMMAND.name: keepalive
COMMAND.help: Not configurable: LDP sends keepalives every holdtime/3 (use holdtime)
COMMAND.ACTION: echo "% LDP keepalive is not configurable: it is always holdtime/3. Use 'holdtime' (3 x the keepalive you want)."; false
